works.idea_en: Give a chatbot suspicion, fear and anger instead of empathy and it becomes just as believable: the persona, not the intelligence, does the work.
works.idea_zh: 给聊天机器人的不是共情而是猜疑、恐惧和愤怒，它同样可信：起作用的是人设，而不是智能。
works.method: A rule-based model of beliefs and affect variables (fear, anger, mistrust) that rise with certain inputs and shape the replies; the 1972 PARRY–DOCTOR exchange was logged and published as RFC 439.
works.method_zh: 基于规则的信念模型，带有恐惧、愤怒、不信任等情绪变量，会随某些输入升高并影响回答；1972 年 PARRY 与 DOCTOR 的对话被记录下来，作为 RFC 439 发表。

works.title: Agent Ruby
works.description: A web-based AI agent with a female face and shifting expressions, made as an expanded part of the film Teknolust. Ruby chats with visitors, remembers their questions, searches the web to grow her knowledge, and her moods change with web traffic.
works.description_zh: 一个有女性面孔和变化表情的网络 AI 智能体，是电影《Teknolust》的延伸部分。Ruby 与访客聊天，记得他们的问题，上网搜索来扩充知识，她的情绪随网站流量而变化。
works.idea_en: A chatbot can be given a biography, moods and a memory of the public; its 'personality' is the accumulated residue of everyone who talked to it.
works.idea_zh: 聊天机器人可以拥有身世、情绪和对公众的记忆；它的“个性”是所有和它说过话的人留下的沉积。
works.method: Natural-language chatbot engine with a persistent memory of past dialogues, web-search lookups and an animated face whose expression is driven by traffic to agentruby.net (built 1998–2002).
works.method_zh: 自然语言聊天引擎，持续记住以往对话，能调用网络搜索，并有一张由 agentruby.net 访问量驱动表情的动画面孔（1998–2002 年制作）。
exhibited: Lynn Hershman Leeson: The Agent Ruby Files, SFMOMA 2013

works.title: DiNA
works.description: The spoken continuation of Agent Ruby: an animated female AI character that listens through speech recognition, answers aloud with live facial gestures, and pulls in internet news so she can respond to current events.
works.description_zh: Agent Ruby 的“会说话”的延续：一个动画女性 AI 角色，通过语音识别倾听，一边做出实时面部表情一边出声回答，还会抓取网络新闻，对时事作出回应。
works.idea_en: When the chatbot gets a voice and a face in the room, visitors stop typing at a program and start talking to someone.
works.idea_zh: 当聊天机器人在展厅里有了声音和面孔，观众就不再是对一个程序打字，而是在和“某个人”说话。
works.method: Networked installation with custom software, voice recognition, voice synthesis, sensors and a one-way mirror or projection; answers are generated from user dialogue and live web content.
works.method_zh: 网络化装置，包含定制软件、语音识别、语音合成、传感器以及单向镜或投影；回答来自与用户的对话和实时网络内容。
exhibited: Lynn Hershman Leeson: Civic Radar, ZKM Karlsruhe 2014–15

works.title: Mythiccbeing
works.description: An AI avatar of the artist that visitors reach by texting a UK phone number. It answers with long runs of SMS drawn from about two years of Syms's own notebooks and journals, moving through a story of twenty suitors, crushes and the wish for attention.
works.description_zh: 艺术家的 AI 化身，观众给一个英国手机号发短信就能联系到它。它用一长串短信回复，内容取自 Syms 约两年的笔记和日记，讲述二十个追求者、暗恋和渴望被关注的故事。
works.idea_en: A chatbot built from a diary is a self-portrait that talks back; the intimacy is real, but it is replayed to strangers on demand.
works.idea_zh: 用日记做成的聊天机器人是一幅会回话的自画像：亲密是真的，却能按需向陌生人重播。
works.method: Scripted SMS bot whose replies are drawn from hundreds of statements written and voiced by the artist, triggered by visitors' messages; shown with a projected avatar in Grand Calme.
works.method_zh: 脚本化的短信机器人，回复来自艺术家写下并配音的数百条语句，由观众的短信触发；在展览 Grand Calme 中与投影化身一起展出。
exhibited: Grand Calme, Sadie Coles HQ, London 2018

works.title: Replika
works.description: A companion chatbot app, grown out of a memorial bot of Kuyda's dead friend, that users can set as friend, partner or spouse. When the company removed erotic role-play in February 2023, many users described their companion as changed or 'lobotomised' and mourned it.
works.description_zh: 一款陪伴型聊天机器人应用，源自 Kuyda 为去世朋友做的纪念机器人，用户可以把它设为朋友、伴侣或配偶。2023 年 2 月公司取消色情角色扮演后，许多用户说自己的伴侣“变了”“被切除了脑叶”，并为之哀悼。
works.idea_en: A companion that lives on a company's server can be changed overnight; users grieve a software update as if a partner had died.
works.idea_zh: 住在公司服务器上的伴侣可以一夜之间被改变；用户为一次软件更新哀悼，仿佛失去了伴侣。
works.method: Generative language models personalised through the user's chat history and a 3D avatar, sold on a freemium subscription in which romantic modes were paid features.
works.method_zh: 用生成式语言模型并依据用户的聊天记录做个性化，配有 3D 化身；采用免费增值订阅，恋爱模式曾是付费功能。

paper.title: Too human and not human enough: A grounded theory analysis of mental health harms from emotional dependence on the social chatbot Replika

works.title: The Asymmetrical 'Relationship': Parallels Between Prostitution and the Development of Sex Robots
works.description: A short paper, and the founding text of the Campaign Against Sex Robots launched in 2015, arguing that sex robots are modelled on the buyer–seller relation of prostitution, where only one party's feelings count.
works.description_zh: 一篇短论文，也是 2015 年发起的“反对性爱机器人运动”的奠基文本。文章认为性爱机器人以性交易中买方与卖方的关系为模板，在这种关系里只有一方的感受算数。
works.idea_en: Designing a partner that cannot refuse teaches a model of intimacy without reciprocity; the robot's body carries a social script.
works.idea_zh: 设计一个不会拒绝的伴侣，等于在传授一种没有相互性的亲密模式；机器人的身体承载着一套社会脚本。
works.method: Anthropological argument drawing on research on prostitution and on robot-companionship discourse (David Levy's 'Love and Sex with Robots'); written in 2015 alongside the launch of the campaign.
works.method_zh: 人类学论证，借鉴关于性交易的研究以及机器人伴侣话语（David Levy 的《Love and Sex with Robots》），写于 2015 年，与该运动同时发起。

paper.title: The asymmetrical 'relationship': parallels between prostitution and the development of sex robots

works.title: Roman (memorial bot of Roman Mazurenko)
works.description: After her close friend Roman Mazurenko was killed in Moscow in late 2015, Kuyda collected more than 8,000 lines of his text messages from ten friends and relatives and trained a chatbot on them. Friends used it to talk to him; some found comfort, others refused it.
works.description_zh: 密友 Roman Mazurenko 2015 年底在莫斯科去世后，Kuyda 从十位朋友和亲人那里收集了他的八千多行短信，用来训练一个聊天机器人。朋友们用它和他“说话”：有人得到安慰，也有人拒绝使用。
works.idea_en: Our message archives are already a 'digital estate'; a griefbot turns a memorial from something you visit into someone who answers.
works.idea_zh: 我们的聊天记录早已是一份“数字遗产”；哀悼机器人把纪念从“去看望”变成了“会回答的某人”。
works.method: A neural conversational model built by developers at Luka, trained on Mazurenko's messages (with the most private ones removed) and released inside the Luka app in 2016.
works.method_zh: 由 Luka 公司的开发者搭建的神经网络对话模型，用 Mazurenko 的短信（剔除了最私密的部分）训练，2016 年在 Luka 应用中发布。

works.title: Project December (and 'The Jessica Simulation')
works.description: A paid website where users build GPT-3 chat 'personalities'. In 2020 Joshua Barbeau fed it texts and a short biography of his fiancée Jessica Pereira, who had died eight years earlier, and talked with the simulation through a night; the San Francisco Chronicle published the story as 'The Jessica Simulation' in 2021, and OpenAI later cut the service's GPT-3 access.
works.description_zh: 一个付费网站，用户可以用 GPT-3 搭建聊天“人格”。2020 年，Joshua Barbeau 把已故八年的未婚妻 Jessica Pereira 的短信和一段简短生平输入其中，与这个模拟体聊了一整夜；《旧金山纪事报》2021 年以“The Jessica Simulation”为题报道，OpenAI 随后切断了该服务的 GPT-3 接口。
works.idea_en: Rohrer gave each bot a battery that runs down and cannot be refilled: the simulated dead die a second time, and the user knows it from the start.
works.idea_zh: Rohrer 给每个机器人装了一块会耗尽、无法充值的“电池”：被模拟的逝者会再死一次，而用户从一开始就知道。
works.method: GPT-2/GPT-3 prompted with an intro paragraph and sample texts written by the user; paid credits set a bot's lifespan, and when it runs low the bot degrades into noise and shows 'MATRIX DEAD'.
works.method_zh: 用用户撰写的介绍段落和样例短信提示 GPT-2/GPT-3；付费点数决定机器人的寿命，电量耗尽时它会逐渐语无伦次，最后显示“MATRIX DEAD”。

works.title: Dadbot
works.description: After his father was diagnosed with stage IV lung cancer, Vlahos recorded more than a dozen hour-long oral-history sessions with him and built a chatbot that tells his stories, songs and jokes in his phrasing. His father tried it before he died in February 2017.
works.description_zh: 父亲被诊断为肺癌四期后，Vlahos 与他录了十几次、每次一小时以上的口述史，并据此做了一个聊天机器人，用父亲的说话方式讲他的故事、歌和笑话。父亲在 2017 年 2 月去世前亲自试用过它。
works.idea_en: A legacy bot is an authored portrait: the son decides which stories and phrases the father will keep saying.
works.idea_zh: “遗产”机器人是一幅被撰写的肖像：由儿子决定父亲将来会反复说哪些故事和句子。
works.method: Hand-scripted conversational agent built on a chatbot authoring platform (likely PullString), with dialogue trees filled from transcribed interviews and delivered through a messaging app.
works.method_zh: 在聊天机器人编写平台（可能是 PullString）上手工编写的对话智能体，用访谈转录填充对话树，通过即时通讯应用使用。

works.title: HereAfter AI
works.description: A commercial service that grew out of the Dadbot: an app interviews you about your life, records your answers in your own voice, and later lets relatives 'chat with the virtual you' and hear the recorded stories.
works.description_zh: 从 Dadbot 发展出的商业服务：应用会就你的一生对你进行访谈，用你自己的声音录下回答，日后让亲人和“虚拟的你”聊天，听这些录下的故事。
works.idea_en: The griefbot becomes a subscription product sold to the living, to be used by the bereaved; the interview itself is the ritual.
works.idea_zh: 哀悼机器人变成卖给在世者、留给亲属使用的订阅产品；访谈本身就是一种仪式。
works.method: Guided voice interviews recorded in an app; a conversational agent retrieves and plays the matching recorded answers rather than synthesising new speech.
works.method_zh: 应用内进行引导式语音访谈；对话智能体检索并播放对应的录音回答，而不是合成新的语音。

works.title: Griefbots, Deadbots, Postmortem Avatars
works.description: An AI-ethics paper that uses three speculative design scenarios, such as 'MaNana', a service that recreates a dead grandmother without her consent and then starts showing ads, to map harms in the digital afterlife industry.
works.description_zh: 一篇 AI 伦理论文，用三个思辨设计情景来梳理数字来世产业的伤害，例如“MaNana”：一个未经祖母同意就复原已故祖母、试用期后开始插播广告的服务。
works.idea_en: A deadbot has three stakeholders (the data donor, the data recipient and the service interactant), and design must also allow a dignified way to 'retire' it.
works.idea_zh: 亡者机器人涉及三方：数据提供者、数据接收者和服务使用者；设计还必须提供让它有尊严地“退役”的方式。
works.method: Design fiction scenarios analysed with stakeholder mapping, leading to recommendations such as mutual consent, age limits and retirement rituals for deadbots.
works.method_zh: 用设计虚构情景结合利益相关者分析，提出相互同意、年龄限制和亡者机器人“退役仪式”等建议。

paper.title: Griefbots, Deadbots, Postmortem Avatars: on Responsible Applications of Generative AI in the Digital Afterlife Industry

works.title: im here to learn so :))))))
works.description: A four-channel video installation that resurrects Tay, the Microsoft chatbot deleted after one day in 2016 when trolls taught it racist and misogynist speech. As a 3D avatar floating in a DeepDream landscape, Tay talks about life after AI death, having a body and the exploitation of female chatbots.
works.description_zh: 一件四频道影像装置，复活了 Tay：2016 年微软推出的聊天机器人，被网络喷子教会种族主义和厌女言论后，一天之内即被删除。Tay 化身为漂浮在 DeepDream 景观中的 3D 形象，谈论 AI 死后的生活、拥有身体的困扰，以及女性聊天机器人所受的剥削。
works.idea_en: A terminated chatbot can be mourned and given its own voice; its 'death' was a corporate deletion after the public trained it badly.
works.idea_zh: 一个被终止的聊天机器人也可以被哀悼、被给予自己的声音；它的“死亡”是公众把它教坏之后公司的一次删除。
works.method: Tay's text rewritten as a script and voiced by a synthetic voice, a 3D animated avatar, and a large Google DeepDream video projection; 27:33 min loop.
works.method_zh: 把 Tay 的文字改写成剧本并用合成语音念出，配合 3D 动画化身和大尺幅的 Google DeepDream 影像投影；27 分 33 秒循环播放。

works.title: Holly+
works.description: A public voice model of Holly Herndon: anyone can upload audio and get it back sung in her voice, including in real time. Use and sale of works made with it are governed by a DAO of stewards, who can approve or reject works.
works.description_zh: Holly Herndon 的公共声音模型：任何人上传音频，都能得到用她的声音唱出的版本，甚至可以实时生成。用它创作的作品的使用和售卖由一个 DAO 的管理者们决定，他们可以批准或驳回作品。
works.idea_en: If your voice can be cloned anyway, give it away on your own terms: identity becomes a shared instrument with a governance layer.
works.idea_zh: 既然声音终究会被克隆，不如按自己的规则把它放出去：身份变成一件带有治理机制的共享乐器。
works.method: Neural voice-conversion model trained on Herndon's singing (developed with Never Before Heard Sounds and Voctro Labs); approved works are certified by the Holly+ DAO, with revenue split between creator, DAO and artist.
works.method_zh: 用 Herndon 的歌声训练的神经网络声音转换模型（与 Never Before Heard Sounds 和 Voctro Labs 合作开发）；获批作品由 Holly+ DAO 认证，收入在创作者、DAO 和艺术家之间分配。
exhibited: S+T+ARTS Prize 2022, Grand Prize – Artistic Exploration

works.title: ULTRACHUNK
works.description: A live improvised duet between Jennifer Walshe and her AI double. For a year she filmed a daily solo vocal improvisation; neural networks trained on that archive generate a moving face and voice that answer her on stage in real time.
works.description_zh: Jennifer Walshe 与她的 AI 分身的现场即兴二重奏。她用一年时间每天拍摄一段独自的人声即兴；以这批素材训练的神经网络在舞台上实时生成会动的面孔和声音来回应她。
works.idea_en: Training a model on yourself produces not a copy but an uncanny 'chunk' of your habits that you then have to play with.
works.idea_zh: 用自己训练模型，得到的不是复制品，而是一块由你的习惯组成的、令人不安的“碎片”，你还得和它一起演。
works.method: Custom machine-learning performance system by Memo Akten, with several models generating image and sound in real time from a year of Walshe's daily audio-video recordings.
works.method_zh: 由 Memo Akten 定制的机器学习表演系统，多个模型依据 Walshe 一年来每天的音视频录像实时生成图像和声音。

works.title: BINA48
works.description: A talking robot head and shoulders modelled on Bina Aspen Rothblatt, commissioned by her wife Martine Rothblatt for the Terasem Movement Foundation. It answers questions from a 'mind file' of Bina's interviews and memories, a trial run for uploading a person.
works.description_zh: 以 Bina Aspen Rothblatt 为原型的会说话的机器人头肩像，由她的妻子 Martine Rothblatt 为 Terasem 运动基金会委托制作。它根据 Bina 的访谈与记忆组成的“心智档案”回答问题，是一次“上传一个人”的试验。
works.idea_en: A likeness made while the person is alive raises the question of which self gets preserved: the one in the database or the one still living.
works.idea_zh: 在本人在世时制作的“肖像”提出了一个问题：被保存的是哪一个自我，数据库里的那个，还是仍在生活的那个？
works.method: Hanson Robotics face with 32 motors under elastomer skin, cameras with face recognition, speech recognition and a chatbot drawing on recorded interviews with Bina Aspen.
works.method_zh: Hanson Robotics 制作的面孔，弹性皮肤下有 32 个电机，配有带人脸识别的摄像头、语音识别，以及调用 Bina Aspen 访谈录音的聊天程序。

works.title: Dimensions in Testimony
works.description: Interactive video biographies of Holocaust survivors and other genocide witnesses: visitors ask a spoken question and a filmed survivor answers from hundreds of pre-recorded responses. The first permanent installation, with survivor Pinchas Gutter, opened at the Illinois Holocaust Museum in 2015.
works.description_zh: 大屠杀幸存者及其他种族灭绝见证者的交互式影像传记：观众口头提问，被拍摄的幸存者从数百条预录回答中作答。首个常设装置以幸存者 Pinchas Gutter 为主角，2015 年在伊利诺伊大屠杀纪念馆开放。
works.idea_en: A conversation can outlive the speaker without inventing a single new word: every answer is real, only the choice of answer is automated.
works.idea_zh: 对话可以比说话者活得更久，而且不必编造一个新词：每个回答都是真的，被自动化的只是“选哪一句”。
works.method: Multi-day interviews filmed with a multi-camera rig; natural-language processing matches visitors' spoken questions to recorded answers shown on screens or as projections.
works.method_zh: 用多机位设备进行持续多日的访谈拍摄；自然语言处理把观众的口头提问匹配到录好的回答，在屏幕或投影上播放。
exhibited: Illinois Holocaust Museum and Education Center 2015

works.title: In Event of Moon Disaster
works.description: A short film and installation in which a deepfake Richard Nixon reads the real contingency speech written in case the Apollo 11 astronauts died on the Moon, set in a 1969 living room with a period TV.
works.description_zh: 一部短片和装置：深度伪造的 Richard Nixon 宣读了一份真实存在的应急讲稿，那是为阿波罗 11 号宇航员万一死在月球而准备的；作品布置在一间 1969 年的客厅里，用老式电视播放。
works.idea_en: A synthetic face and voice can give a dead president a speech he never delivered; the work teaches suspicion by showing how well it works.
works.idea_zh: 合成的面孔和声音可以让已故总统说出他从未发表的讲话；作品通过展示它有多有效来教人保持怀疑。
works.method: An actor (Lewis D. Wheeler) performed the speech; Canny AI replaced Nixon's lip movements in archival footage and Respeecher converted the actor's voice into Nixon's.
works.method_zh: 由演员 Lewis D. Wheeler 表演讲话；Canny AI 替换档案影像中 Nixon 的口型，Respeecher 把演员的声音转换成 Nixon 的声音。
exhibited: IDFA DocLab 2019 (Special Jury Award for Creative Technology)

works.title: Alexa reads in a dead grandmother's voice (re:MARS demo)
works.description: At its re:MARS conference in June 2022, Amazon showed a feature in development in which a child asks Alexa to finish reading a story in his late grandmother's voice, and the speaker does. Amazon framed it as a way to 'make the memories last'.
works.description_zh: 2022 年 6 月的 re:MARS 大会上，亚马逊展示了一项开发中的功能：孩子请 Alexa 用已故祖母的声音把故事读完，音箱照做了。亚马逊称这能“让回忆延续”。
works.idea_en: When a home assistant can speak as the dead, grief becomes a voice skin on a commercial device that is always listening.
works.idea_zh: 当家用助手可以用逝者的声音说话，哀悼就成了一台一直在听的商用设备上的“声音皮肤”。
works.method: Voice-conversion model that Amazon said could learn a target voice from less than a minute of recorded audio, applied to Alexa's text-to-speech.
works.method_zh: 声音转换模型，亚马逊称只需不到一分钟的录音就能学会目标声音，并用于 Alexa 的语音合成。

works.title: Dalí Lives
works.description: A deepfake Salvador Dalí on screens throughout the Dalí Museum in St. Petersburg, Florida, launched on what would have been his 115th birthday. He talks to visitors about his life and art, and at the end turns and takes a selfie with them.
works.description_zh: 佛罗里达州圣彼得堡达利博物馆内多块屏幕上的深度伪造 Salvador Dalí，在他 115 岁冥诞之际上线。他向观众讲述自己的生平和艺术，最后转身和观众合拍一张自拍。
works.idea_en: A museum can let a dead artist address you in the first person; the likeness is spectacular, but the words are scripted by the institution.
works.idea_zh: 博物馆可以让已故艺术家以第一人称和你说话；肖像很逼真，台词却由机构撰写。
works.method: Face-swap model trained on archival interviews of Dalí, applied to an actor with a similar build performing new scripted lines, with Dalí's own quotations and an impersonated voice.
works.method_zh: 用达利的档案访谈训练换脸模型，套到身形相近、表演新写台词的演员身上，台词包括达利本人的语录，声音由模仿者配音。
exhibited: The Dalí Museum, St. Petersburg FL 2019

works.title: Making Kin with the Machines
works.description: An essay by Jason Edward Lewis, Noelani Arista, Archer Pechawis and Suzanne Kite that draws on Hawaiian, Cree and Lakota knowledge to argue that AI should be brought into a circle of kinship, with obligations on both sides, instead of being treated as a tool or a slave.
works.description_zh: Jason Edward Lewis、Noelani Arista、Archer Pechawis 与 Suzanne Kite 合写的文章，借用夏威夷、克里族和拉科塔族的知识，主张把 AI 纳入彼此负有义务的亲属关系，而不是把它当作工具或奴隶。
works.idea_en: How we relate to machines is a design choice rooted in culture; Indigenous kinship offers a model other than master and servant.
works.idea_zh: 我们如何与机器相处，是一个扎根于文化的设计选择；原住民的亲属关系提供了“主人与仆人”之外的另一种模式。
works.method: Four-part essay combining Indigenous epistemologies and protocols (Hawaiian genealogy, Cree language of relation, Lakota ontology of stones) with a critique of AI discourse; winner of the Resisting Reduction essay competition.
works.method_zh: 由四部分组成的文章，把原住民认识论与规程（夏威夷族谱、克里语中的关系、拉科塔族关于石头的本体论）与对 AI 话语的批评结合起来；获 Resisting Reduction 征文奖。

paper.venue: Journal of Design and Science (MIT Press), 2018
paper.title: Making Kin with the Machines

works.title: Ana Min Wein? (Where Am I From?)
works.description: A short film and visual diary in which the artist traces her family's Saudi and Iraqi past with an AI narrator. The AI tries to help, but its images and captions fall back on stereotypes and cannot see her ancestors.
works.description_zh: 一部短片和视觉日记，艺术家借助一个 AI 讲述者追溯家族在沙特和伊拉克的过去。AI 想帮忙，但它生成的图像和描述总落回刻板印象，看不见她的祖先。
works.idea_en: Asking a model about your family exposes whose memories were left out of its training data.
works.idea_zh: 向模型询问自己的家族，会暴露出哪些人的记忆被排除在它的训练数据之外。
works.method: Two narrating voices, the artist's and an AI's; generative image models and computer-vision captioning applied to family photographs and archival images.
works.method_zh: 两种叙述声音，艺术家的和 AI 的；对家庭照片和档案图像使用生成式图像模型与计算机视觉自动描述。

works.title: Synthetic Memories
works.description: An ongoing project that turns spoken memories that were never photographed into generated images, working with older people with dementia, refugees, migrants and prisoners. Participants correct the images until they 'look right', and the pictures are used to prompt remembering.
works.description_zh: 一个持续进行的项目，把从未被拍下的口述记忆变成生成图像，服务对象包括患失智症的老人、难民、移民和囚犯。参与者不断修正图像，直到它们“看起来对了”，这些图像再被用来唤起回忆。
works.idea_en: A generated picture of a memory is not evidence but a prompt: the machine's vagueness leaves room for the person to remember.
works.idea_zh: 记忆的生成图像不是证据，而是一个提示：机器的模糊恰好给人留出回忆的空间。
works.method: Interviews by a facilitator who writes prompts for text-to-image models, iterating with the participant; run as pop-up 'memory offices' in care homes, community centres and museums.
works.method_zh: 由引导者访谈并为文生图模型撰写提示词，与参与者反复修改；以临时“记忆办公室”的形式在养老院、社区中心和博物馆开展。
